557:t_001:16.en:
$$カヲル$$
(You feel it too, don't you, $$シンジ$$? The same air as that place...)

557:t_001:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. I will find $$千鳥$$ and end all of this.」

557:t_001:19.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$, no matter where you are or what the situation is, I will do it...!)

557:t_001:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please be careful, everyone. Even I don't know what kind of moves $$レナード$$ has prepared.」

557:t_001:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's what we came here for!」

557:t_001:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「This world belongs to everyone who lives here! Like hell I'll let anyone selfishly restore spacetime!」

557:t_001:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We settle things with $$アマルガム$$ here!」

557:t_001:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$千鳥$$! I'm coming now!!」

557:t_002:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「So they also seek the transformation of the world?」

557:t_003:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Angels!? And ones we already beat, back again!」

557:t_003:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「What's going on!? There's even the one that possessed Unit-03!」

557:t_003:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It must be because of the space here.」

557:t_003:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Cause and effect are already muddled together here. Things like before and after have no meaning.」

557:t_003:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「So those guys came from the past or wherever, convinced that $$セントラルドグマ$$ is here!?」

557:t_003:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If you force a rationale onto it, yes.」

557:t_003:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
(And what drew them here must be the existence of that thing.)

557:t_003:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The Angel that hurt $$アスカ$$... and the Angel that took $$綾波$$ away...」

557:t_003:12.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Those guys... I'm the one who'll take them down...!」

557:t_003:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be careful! The Angels are ignoring $$アマルガム$$ and seem to be targeting only us!」

557:t_003:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Because the EVAs are with us!」

557:t_003:15.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Who cares! If they're coming at us, I'll take them on!」

557:t_003:17.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I know, $$シンジ$$. Dealing with them is our job.」

557:t_003:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「How convenient. They'll stop $c for us.」

557:t_003:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「How pitiful, hollow wanderers seeking new life. But we can't let you have that.」

557:t_007:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Wh-what are you saying!?」

557:t_007:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Wh-what are you saying!?」

557:t_007:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Do you have a death wish, you two!?」

557:t_007:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If the past can't be changed, what will you do, $$シンジ$$?」

557:t_007:11.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If you have to live suffering over what you've done, there's also the option of running away from it.」

557:t_007:14.en:
$$シモン$$
「I don't know what happened to you, but right now you're fighting alongside us!」

557:t_007:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$碇シンジ$$! Even if the past can't be changed, the future can!」

557:t_007:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you've turned your back on the past, your eyes must be looking forward!!」

557:t_007:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your father's shackles and fate don't matter! What are you looking at now!?」

557:t_010:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Either way, a spear has gone into an EVA...」

557:t_010:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「What do you say, Princess? Shall we take it out since it's dangerous?」

557:t_010:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「But if it ever comes to both spears being together, then...」
